title: Speaker Notes Display Version
language: Chinese with canonical technical terms preserved in English

comprehension_brief.Thesis: The project is not only a segmentation model; it is a tunnel defect inspection system that detects defects, explains confidence, flags review risk, and expresses engineering location.
comprehension_brief.Structure: Problem, dataset, system flow, SegFormer backbone, adaptive enhancement, evidence, Web demo, multidomain extension, spatial mapping, patent direction, next steps.
comprehension_brief.Methods: SegFormer B1, 6-class semantic segmentation, mIoU evaluation, adaptive mask selection, uncertainty review, morphology evidence, spatial mapping, multidomain schema, Web drag-and-drop demo.

narrative_arc.Opening: A usable tunnel defect system must answer whether the mask is trustworthy and where the defect is, not only whether a mask exists.
narrative_arc.Middle: SegFormer improves the mask source, while adaptive selection, review evidence, and spatial mapping make results inspectable and reportable.
narrative_arc.Close: The current system can train, evaluate, explain, locate, and demonstrate results; next work should optimize blocky defects, add real calibration/sensor data, and refine patent cases.
